name: Nijigen kara no Akairo
source: Koudou Susumu has been bullied his whole life, and he learned how to draw cute girls as a method of escapism. One day, one of his favorite drawings suddenly comes to life, but there's something off about her...
translation: 幸道进一生都受到欺凌，学会画可爱女孩以逃避现实。某天，他最喜欢的一幅画突然活了过来，但她似乎有些不对劲……
